order_wins: **TruAlt Bioenergy** -- is allocated 2,74,832 KL of ethanol for supply year 2026-27 by BPCL, HPCL, IOCL and MRPL, Rs 1,715.27 cr before freight and taxes; a separate 30,000 KL supply to Nayara Energy is Rs 189 cr (~57.7% of mcap).

**HFCL** -- secures export orders of about Rs 834.36 cr (USD 88.94 mn) for optical fibre cables through its overseas subsidiary from an international customer, to be executed by June 2027 (~2.6% of mcap).
**Modi Naturals** -- subsidiary Modi Biotech is allocated about 7.82 crore litres of ethanol by oil marketing companies, estimated Rs 495 cr, for November 2026 to October 2027 (~113% of mcap).
**ABS Marine Services** -- M.V. Ocean Diamond wins a 36-month charter from Oil India worth about Rs 119.12 cr including GST and a 12-month extension (~16.8% of mcap).
**Vinyas Innovative Technologies** -- receives a Rs 40.89 cr purchase order from a domestic customer for PCBA manufacture and supply, 8-12 months (~2.1% of mcap).
**Dev Information Technology** -- Vadodara Municipal Corporation work order for IT consulting and staff augmentation, about Rs 15.50 cr over three years (~14.3% of mcap).
**Dev Information Technology** -- Gujarat Metro Rail work order for Autodesk Forma model-management software with training and support, about Rs 1.58 cr (~1.3% of mcap).
**Praruh Technologies** -- Letter of Acceptance from Delhi Metro Rail Corporation worth Rs 7.81 cr to upgrade telecom network infrastructure on Lines 1, 2 and 3, six months (~3.6% of mcap).

**Dynacons Systems & Solutions** -- order worth USD 6.83 mn from Dominica's Caribbean Digital Transformation Project Unit for IT infrastructure across 3 hospitals and 49 health centres; no rupee value given, so no mcap ratio.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Godrej Industries** -- subsidiary Godrej Capital takes Rs 2,500 cr of primary capital from Temasek's affiliate Jongsong at a valuation of up to Rs 28,000 cr; the Group keeps about 80%.
**Yatharth Hospital** -- receives CCI approval (10-Nov) for its proposed preferential issue of about Rs 3,150 cr to Rasmalai Limited (Cyprus), 24.87% of post-issue capital; other approvals pending.
**Dhruva Capital Services** -- opens its qualified institutions placement of up to Rs 160 cr with a floor price of Rs 78.02 a share.
**AGI Infra** -- opens its qualified institutions placement with a floor price of Rs 269.205 a share after the 4-Nov postal ballot; issue size not stated in the pages read.
**Emiac Technologies** -- Board approves a preferential issue of 32,75,000 warrants at Rs 91.49 each, about Rs 29.96 cr, subject to shareholder approval.

**Mudunuru** -- Board proposes 2,48,33,921 convertible warrants at Rs 2 each (as printed) and 33,70,000 equity shares on a preferential basis to promoter-group and public allottees, subject to an EGM; share price not in the pages read.
**Praxis Home Retail** -- Committee of Directors fixes a Rs 51.61 cr rights issue of 10,32,29,005 equity shares at Rs 5 each, assuming full subscription.
**Geetanjali Credit and Capital** -- Board sets the payment schedule for its rights issue of up to Rs 90 cr: Rs 6.25 on application and Rs 6.25 on a final call (25-31 Dec) per partly paid share.
**Ironwood Education** -- Board fixes 18-Nov as the record date for its rights issue of up to Rs 24 cr.

**Kirloskar Electric** -- receives BSE and NSE listing approval for 34,68,007 shares issued preferentially to promoter-group Kirloskar Power Equipments at a Rs 115.34 floor price, about Rs 40 cr (our arithmetic).
equity_allotments: **Gamco** -- allots 40,91,960 fresh equity shares at Rs 50 each to non-promoter allottees on a preferential basis, Rs 20.46 cr received (new shares).
**Aptus Pharma** -- allots 15,97,470 fresh equity shares at Rs 280 each on a preferential basis, Rs 44.73 cr (new shares).
**Pelatro** -- allots 6,85,000 convertible warrants at Rs 400 each, Rs 27.40 cr, to promoter and public allottees, exercisable within 18 months (fresh warrants).
**Simplex Castings** -- allots 10,53,312 equity shares at Rs 105 (Rs 11.06 cr) and 7,26,809 convertible warrants to non-promoter allottees after BSE's in-principle approval.
m_and_a: **Phoenix Mills** -- subsidiary Island Star Mall Developers completes the NCLT-approved cancellation of CPP Investments' 3,25,69,360 shares, paying Rs 1,350 cr; Phoenix's stake rises from 58.33% to 68.10%.
**Aeroflex Neu** -- completes buying 1,10,000 shares of Aerolex Cables, the 55% stake announced on 30-Oct, for Rs 31 cr (~14.0% of mcap).
**Union Bank of India** -- invests a further Rs 336.51 cr in joint venture Star Union Dai-ichi Life Insurance, lifting its holding from 25.10% to 26.24%.

**Kaynes Technology** -- signs a binding term sheet with Vishay for a semiconductor OSAT joint venture through Kaynes Semicon, with Vishay investing for a 49% stake; definitive agreements and approvals pending, no value stated.
**eClerx** -- announces the acquisition of RegEdge, a New York regulatory-consulting boutique; consideration not stated in the release.
**Mudunuru** -- Board approves acquiring 51% of Mudunuru Hospitality Pvt Ltd to make it a subsidiary; consideration not stated in the pages read.
**One Global Service Provider** -- completes acquiring 51% each of Matrix Labs Diagnocare and Matrix Labs for consideration other than cash; both become subsidiaries, value not stated.
**GAIL (India)** -- signs an MoU with KRIBHCO to explore a gas-based urea plant of 1.27 MMTPA at Mulapeta, Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh; exploratory, no cost stated.

**NBCC (India)** -- signs MoUs with West Bengal's urban development department and authorities for six project areas on deposit-work terms, actual cost plus 5% agency charges; project cost not yet given.
capex_core: **EIH** -- Board approves a Rs 777 cr five-star Trident hotel near Shamshabad Airport, Hyderabad, funded by internal accruals and debt, operational by September 2030.
**WeWork India** -- signs leases for 3,13,633 sq ft in Hyderabad to add about 4,256 desks by July 2027, investment about Rs 144 cr, funded by internal accruals and debt.
business_updates: **Oil India** -- Q2 FY27 standalone PAT up 116% to Rs 2,259 cr from Rs 1,044 cr on 20% higher crude output and USD 92.24 a barrel realisation; consolidated PAT Rs 2,521 cr, up 53%.
**VIP Industries** -- Q2 FY27 consolidated income rises 15% to Rs 468 cr and the EBITDA loss narrows to Rs 27 cr from Rs 96 cr a year earlier.
**Sical Logistics** -- Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 105.5 cr, up 17.4% YoY, and H1 revenue Rs 238 cr, up 27.1% (Rs 1,055 mn and Rs 2,380 mn per the release).
**Dar Credit & Capital** -- Q2 FY27 total income Rs 15.22 cr, up 26.8% YoY, with operating revenue Rs 14.97 cr; H1 operating revenue Rs 28.25 cr, up 23.6%.
**Premier Roadlines** -- H1 FY27 revenue from operations rises 18.3% YoY to Rs 166.8 cr on 17,487 orders (+2.8%), with contract-logistics margins under pressure.
**Crown Lifters** -- CMD's Q2 FY27 business update puts H1 turnover at Rs 14.80 cr, which he says understates a period of fleet repositioning and long-term order wins.
**GRE Renew Enertech** -- fortnightly update: orders received 15-31 Oct aggregate Rs 1.50 cr (Rs 1,50,47,783), in the ordinary course of business.
**Modi Naturals** -- subsidiary Modi Biotech starts commercial operations at its expanded Chhattisgarh grain-based ethanol plant, capacity raised from 282 KLPD to 600 KLPD.
**MRPL** -- its Rs 330 cr Devangonthi marketing terminal in Bengaluru, 77,000 kL of storage for petrol, diesel and ATF, is to be dedicated to the nation on 13-Nov.
**Rama Phosphates** -- starts trial production of single super phosphate in Phase-I of its greenfield Nardana (Dhule) plant; commercial production awaits statutory approvals.
distress_risk: **Bharat Forge** -- NCLT Mumbai approves the resolution plan for step-down subsidiary Tork Motors (Kalyani Powertrain holds 64.29%); existing equity is extinguished and Tork leaves the group on implementation.
**Vardhman Polytex** -- reaches an amicable settlement with operational creditor Bhagwati Cotton, which had filed a Section 9 IBC application at NCLT Chandigarh (claim about Rs 40.70 cr).

**Waaree Energies** -- answers a 11-Nov press report: the US ITC report covers all Indian solar exporters, no finding or penalty is assessed against Waaree, and the origin-reporting issue touched a limited set of past US shipments.
other_notable: **Zee Entertainment** -- Board approves a Rs 600 cr tender-offer buyback of up to 6,59,34,065 shares at Rs 91 each, 7.22% standalone and 6.61% consolidated of paid-up capital and free reserves.
**Jullundur Motor Agency (Delhi)** -- Board approves a tender-offer buyback of up to 20,00,000 shares at Rs 112, Rs 22.40 cr, record date 18-Nov.
**HEG Advanced Materials** -- subsidiary TACC signs a non-binding MoU with a global lithium-ion cell maker for up to 40,000 tonnes of synthetic anode material; no value stated.

**Clean Max Enviro Energy** -- MoU with Andhra Pradesh to invest about Rs 50,000 cr over five years in 3 GW of renewables and 1 GW of pumped storage to power a 2 GW compute factory; an MoU, not a contract.
